verdict.rationale: Twilio's own Phone Numbers API docs say you can search for and buy available Twilio phone numbers, which is the core of this story. Community users confirm they hold and use Twilio-issued numbers. However, filtering by area code and the 'in minutes' speed are not evidenced, and regulatory bundle requirements in some countries (e.g. Germany) can slow acquisition. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of area-code search filters, evidence of minutes-level purchase time, independent hands-on confirmation of the search-and-buy flow.
